units.implementationStatus: Partial: merged PR2 provides engine-owned durable budget commands, immutable revisions, audit/outbox, bounded receipt callbacks and one-shot consumption. PR3 adds monotonic callback admission/result gates and signal cleanup. PR4 checks stored current budget membership, full reservation principal/purpose and required overage role under the project lock before cached responses, preserving legacy fingerprints. Twenty-one local tests/typecheck/build/registry and fifteen installed public-export migration groups pass; final-head CI is required. Host identity/receipt services, authenticated controls, independent network-session and deployment qualification remain pending. Current WIP adds disposable PostgreSQL17 separate-session reservation/consumption/lost-acknowledgement and observed-lock authorization verification; actual CI qualification remains pending.
